note: Realistic filled-in states in the scoring engine's shape. `expected` is computed by `bin/test-personas --update` and verified by `bin/test-personas`. Flags: this is a split engine, so the detector is pinned as expected.flaggedIssues via flagsHint "detectFlaggedIssues" with flagsArgs ["state","result.qsofaScore"], mirroring form-app.js's call detectFlaggedIssues(state, grade.qsofaScore); the wall clock is frozen at the oracle's default while grading.

personas.name: lower-score-0
personas.description: Normal respiratory rate, alert (GCS 15), normal blood pressure: qSOFA 0 — lower risk, continue standard monitoring.

firedCriteria.description: qSOFA < 2 — negative screen; lower risk band

personas.name: higher-score-2
personas.description: Tachypnoea (RR 24) and hypotension (SBP 96), still alert: qSOFA 2 — positive screen, higher risk of poor outcome.

firedCriteria.description: qSOFA >= 2 — positive screen; higher risk band

flaggedIssues.description: Positive qSOFA screen (score 2 of 3) — higher risk of a poor outcome
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Escalate: obtain senior / critical-care review, calculate a full SOFA score, and initiate a sepsis workup (cultures, lactate, fluids, antibiotics per local policy).

flaggedIssues.description: Systolic blood pressure 96 mmHg at or below the 100 mmHg threshold — risk of shock
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Reassess perfusion, consider fluid resuscitation and continuous blood-pressure monitoring.

flaggedIssues.description: Respiratory rate 24 breaths/min at or above the 22/min threshold
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Check oxygen saturation and work of breathing; consider respiratory support.

personas.name: higher-score-3
personas.description: Tachypnoea (RR 28), altered mentation (GCS 13) and hypotension (SBP 88): qSOFA 3 — positive screen, escalate for sepsis workup.

firedCriteria.description: Altered mentation — Glasgow Coma Scale < 15, or altered from baseline
qSOFA >= 2 — positive screen; higher risk band

flaggedIssues.description: Positive qSOFA screen (score 3 of 3) — higher risk of a poor outcome
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Escalate: obtain senior / critical-care review, calculate a full SOFA score, and initiate a sepsis workup (cultures, lactate, fluids, antibiotics per local policy).

flaggedIssues.description: Systolic blood pressure 88 mmHg at or below the 100 mmHg threshold — risk of shock
flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Reassess perfusion, consider fluid resuscitation and continuous blood-pressure monitoring.

flaggedIssues.suggestedAction: Assess airway and neurology, check glucose, and consider causes of encephalopathy.
